title: An Endothelial Address for the Sphingosine 1-Phosphate Axis: Cell-Type Attribution of 171 Sphingolipid Targets Across 27 Human Cancers.
snippet: Sphingolipid enzymes have been nominated as cancer targets for three decades. Six pathway genes are the target of an approved drug, with every approval being for multiple sclerosis, ulcerative colitis, or a lysosomal storage disease, and none for cancer.
